name: it-toolbox
title: IT Toolbox
description: Sixteen everyday developer tools for timestamps, encoding, hashing, UUIDs, JSON, JWTs, CIDR, cron, colors and text
author: huid

commands.name: timestamp
commands.title: Timestamp
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Convert between timestamps and human-readable dates, in seconds or milliseconds

commands.name: url-encode
commands.title: URL Encode / Decode
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Encode and decode URLs, and break a URL down into its query parameters

commands.name: base64
commands.title: Base64 Encode / Decode
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Encode and decode Base64, URL-safe Base64, hex and binary

commands.name: hash
commands.title: Hash (MD5/SHA)
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32 digests

commands.name: uuid
commands.title: UUID / ULID Generator
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Generate UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID and NanoID values in bulk

commands.name: json
commands.title: JSON Format / Validate
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Format, minify, sort and validate JSON, and turn it into TypeScript interfaces

commands.name: jwt
commands.title: JWT Decoder
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Decode a JWT header and payload, and check whether the token has expired

commands.name: radix-convert
commands.title: Radix Convert
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Convert between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal, Base32 and Base36

commands.name: diff-text
commands.title: Text Diff
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Compare two blocks of text line by line, optionally ignoring case and whitespace

commands.name: crypto-random
commands.title: Random / Password Generator
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Generate strong random passwords, integers and strings

commands.name: case-convert
commands.title: Case Convert
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Convert between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more

commands.name: ip-tool
commands.title: IP / CIDR Tool
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Convert between IPv4, integers and binary, and work out CIDR subnet details

commands.name: cron
commands.title: Cron Parser
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Explain a 5-field cron expression and list its next 10 run times

commands.name: qr-code
commands.title: QR Code Generator
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Turn text or a URL into a QR code

commands.name: color-convert
commands.title: Color Convert
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, with WCAG contrast checks

commands.name: text-transform
commands.title: Text Toolkit
commands.subtitle: IT Toolbox
commands.description: Change case, dedupe lines, sort, trim, and convert text to SQL or CSV
